import json,time
from pathlib import Path
from nisayon.evaluation import evaluate_bundle
from nisayon.engine.io import write_json
out=Path("artifacts/engine-integration-001/temporal-integration-001")
rows=[]
for case,expected in (("D01-gripper-sign","accepted"),("D05-recurrent-carry","rejected")):
 root=Path("artifacts/development-ablation-001")/case/"A/confirmation/execution"
 started=time.perf_counter()
 result=evaluate_bundle(root/"bundle.json",artifact_root=root)
 elapsed=time.perf_counter()-started
 write_json(out/(case+"-evaluation.json"),result)
 decision=result["decision"]
 codes=result.get("reason_codes",[])
 rows.append({"case":case,"decision":decision,"reason_codes":codes,"evaluation_wall_s":elapsed})
 assert decision==expected,(case,decision)
 if case.startswith("D05"): assert "progress_lost" in codes,codes
report={"records":rows,"new_simulator_executions":0,"scope":"Read-only integrated evaluator on original actual stores; original decisions unchanged"}
write_json(out/"finite-readback.json",report)
print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
